data.longcaption: Good for having an AI assistant answer questions and help out in team chats.
data.markdowncontent: Monitors incoming chat conversations in real-time, detecting user intent, contextual needs, and dispatching tool-calling AI agents to generate intelligent responses.

data.longcaption: Good for asking the assistant to run a background job for the team from the chat.
data.markdowncontent: Analyzes conversation context and user instructions to match appropriate automation skills and schedule background AI agent jobs.

data.longcaption: Good for turning chat discussions into project goals and assigned tasks.
data.markdowncontent: Analyzes chat discussions to extract project objectives, automatically creating structured goals, breakdown tasks, and assigning team members within project workspaces.

data.markdowncontent: Provides interactive question-and-answer capabilities over catalog assets and entities, generating contextual suggestion prompts and delivering AI answers retrieved via semantic vector search.
